text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc said Wednesday it named Philip Surles as chief operating officer, a newly created position.
Surles was president, southwestern region, for the company. As chief operating officer, he will be responsible for the manufactured housing operations.
Continuing to report to Walter R. Young Jr, Champion chairman, will be A. Jacqueline Dout, executive vice president and chief financial officer, and Thomas Ensch, president, Champion Motor Coach Inc.

"Phil Surles' expertise and leadership will assist in our continued growth internally and as the leading consolidator of the manufactured home industry," Young said in a statement. "We created this position to expand the management with the growth of the company."
Champion, a manufactured housing company, has grown from 30 plants in 1993 to 51 plants currently through internal growth and acquisition, he added.
